stories.title: آيت نوري وأمين غويري يغادران معسكر الجزائر

en.title: Ait Nouri and Amin Gouiri leave Algeria camp
en.summary: The Algerian Football Federation removed Manchester City player Ryan Ait Nouri from the national team camp following a decision by coach Ibrahim Hamdallah. Amin Gouiri was also excluded from the camp due to a muscle injury.

stories.title: Iran insists on diplomatic solution after Trump rejects peace plan

en.title: Iran insists on diplomatic solution after Trump rejects peace plan
en.summary: Iran stated that only diplomatic negotiations can resolve its conflict with the United States and Israel, after President Trump rejected an Iranian proposal regarding the Strait of Hormuz. Iran's Foreign Minister emphasized that reopening the strait depends on meeting specific conditions.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia calls for protection of international waterways, rejects restrictions on navigation

en.title: Saudi Arabia calls for protection of international waterways, rejects restrictions on navigation
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's foreign minister addressed the UN General Assembly, emphasizing the importance of maintaining freedom of navigation in key waterways including the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea, and rejecting any restrictions or fees imposed by other parties.

stories.title: Saudi Joint Forces commander, Tareq Saleh discuss Yemen military readiness

en.title: Saudi Joint Forces commander, Tareq Saleh discuss Yemen military readiness
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Joint Forces Commander and a Yemeni Presidential Leadership Council member met in Riyadh to review military coordination efforts and discuss strengthening Yemen's armed forces as part of efforts to restore state institutions.

stories.title: Russia calls for implementing US-Iran MoU after Trump rejects new proposal

en.title: Russia calls for implementing US-Iran MoU after Trump rejects new proposal
en.summary: Russia's foreign minister stated that a Pakistan-mediated memorandum of understanding between the US and Iran from June represents a fair agreement and urged its implementation to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, following the US president's rejection of a new Iranian proposal.

stories.title: Commanders of Joint Forces, Yemen’s National Resistance Forces discuss ways to support Yemeni army

en.title: Commanders of Joint Forces, Yemen's National Resistance Forces discuss ways to support Yemeni army
en.summary: Military commanders from the Joint Forces and Yemen's National Resistance Forces met in Riyadh to discuss strengthening the Yemeni Armed Forces. The meeting occurred as Houthi ground operations displace thousands and threaten humanitarian conditions across Yemen.

stories.title: غويري يلحق بآيت نوري خارج صفوف منتخب الجزائر

en.title: Gouiri joins Ait Nouri outside Algeria squad
en.summary: The Algerian national team announced the absence of Marseille forward Amin Gouiri from the squad for the remainder of the camp preparation for African Cup of Nations qualifying matches.

stories.title: New road lanes open in Makkah to ease traffic congestion

en.title: New road lanes open in Makkah to ease traffic congestion
en.summary: The Royal Commission for Makkah City opened newly developed traffic lanes on the Third Ring Road and Prince Saud Al Faisal Road, with a 1.5-kilometer expansion reducing travel times by over 90 percent.

stories.title: ‘I Reject their Proposal,’ Says Trump after Iran’s Offer on Hormuz

en.title: 'I Reject their Proposal,' Says Trump after Iran's Offer on Hormuz
en.summary: Trump rejected a proposal from Iran regarding the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: International Conference on Saudi Arabia’s Efforts to Counter Intellectual Deviations Kicks Off Monday

en.title: International Conference on Saudi Arabia's Efforts to Counter Intellectual Deviations Kicks Off Monday
en.summary: An international conference addressing Saudi Arabia's initiatives to counter intellectual deviations is beginning on Monday.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia intercepts Houthi drones, ballistic missile targeting Riyadh, Khamis Mushait

en.title: Saudi Arabia intercepts Houthi drones, ballistic missile targeting Riyadh, Khamis Mushait
en.summary: Saudi air defenses destroyed two Houthi drones aimed at Riyadh and a ballistic missile targeting the southern city of Khamis Mushait. The coalition spokesperson confirmed ongoing monitoring of missile and drone threats directed at the Kingdom.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia, Pakistan Affirm Continued Joint Efforts to Confront Attacks

en.title: Saudi Arabia, Pakistan Affirm Continued Joint Efforts to Confront Attacks
en.summary: Saudi Arabia and Pakistan reaffirmed their commitment to coordinated efforts in addressing attacks.

en.title: Saudi renewable energy capacity rises 63-fold since 2020
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's renewable energy operating capacity reached 19.3 GW by September 2026, representing a more than 63-fold increase from 2020. The Kingdom continues expanding renewable capacity using its natural resources.

stories.title: ‎Saudi Fisheries: From dividends to two decades of losses

en.title: Saudi Fisheries: From dividends to two decades of losses
en.summary: Saudi Fisheries has experienced annual losses for over 20 years despite multiple restructuring efforts and capital adjustments. The company previously reported profits and paid dividends to shareholders before entering its extended loss period.

stories.title: ‎Saudi Arabia ranks 29th in 2026 travel & tourism index

en.title: Saudi Arabia ranks 29th in 2026 travel & tourism index
en.summary: Saudi Arabia placed 29th globally in the World Economic Forum's 2026 Travel and Tourism Development Index. The Kingdom has improved its ranking by 17 positions since 2019, reflecting growing competitiveness in its tourism sector.

stories.title: ‎Oil prices fall, WTI posts nearly 8% weekly loss

en.title: Oil prices fall, WTI posts nearly 8% weekly loss
en.summary: Oil prices declined as markets considered potential US-Iran ceasefire negotiations. WTI crude recorded a 7.85% loss for the week while US oil rigs increased for the fourth consecutive week.

en.title: Gold prices rise, record weekly losses
en.summary: Gold prices gained 0.5% on Friday but fell 2.25% for the week due to a stronger dollar and expectations of sustained higher US interest rates. Markets assessed a 69% probability of a Fed rate increase in October.
